title: Local Rapid Transit
safeHtml:
'''Local Rapid Transits (LRTs) (Formally named Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division Local Rapid Transit System)''' are regional rail systems operated by Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.

Concept

LRTs, as its name suggests, is designed to be a railway system serving the vicinity to which it belonged to. It is a new railway mode that Nazca Railway established after the Standard Railway and Sub-Standard Railway. Taking the Standard Railway as a whole, Sub-Standard Railways are three quarters that of the scale of Standard Railways, and SLTs is a quarter that of the Standard Railway. However, LRTs are designed to be half the scale of Standard Railways, between Sub-Standard Railways and SLTs.

Proper Nouns

Stop

"Stop" is the term for "Stations" in LRTs.

Development Mode

Similar to , LRTs run as independent rail systems. They do not appear in Main Chapters of Nazca Railway, but would randomly appear in different places. However, an exception to this occurred when was established during Pre-Season 4 Phase 3.

Operation Mode

Normally, the platform of a Stop would not exceed 76m long. Stop facilities would also be simpler than stations, featuring only toilets, Minecart Claim areas and Station teleports. However, sign boards used by stops would be the same as that of stations. Moreover, platforms would use Medjay Platform Gates that are specifically designed for LRTs. Besides of doors opening and closing, LRTs would not feature audio announcements with only visual announcements.

The Departure Routine would also be simplified in a manner that Passengers either have to manually start the Departure Routine at every station or move the Minecart out of the station. In turn, the simplified Departure Routine has halved the departure time taken when compared to conventional Departure Routines.

safeHtml:
'''Los Sengas''', originally named '''Metropolis''' (Now the other name of Downtown), is the official name of the City World of Project Nazca. Los Sengas is based on "Limited Creative Modes", and is established on March 2015.

Districts

Los Sengas can be divided into 42 Major Districts and other sub-districts. The 42 Major Districts is also used for SLT Fare Zones. However, there are also ambiguos areas between different Districts.

Transport

The three main modes of transport in Los Sengas are Rail Transport, Ferry Transport and Road Transport.

Rail Transport

The main modes of rail transport in Los Sengas include Nazca Railway, SLT and other private railways included in the Co-op Railway scheme.

Ferry Transport

Ferry Transport in Los Sengas is mainly provided by the Nazca Ferry Co. Ltd. (Also known as the NFC). However, other private ferry companies, such as Hatace Ferry Corporation Limited are also available.

Road Transport

Los Sengas currently has 10 main Trunk Roads scattered across Los Sengas, and the road transport is currently expanding. Moreover, Bus Operators, such as NR Buses, are also available.

Government

'''The Government of Los Sengas''' was the general term used to group all different departments of the Los Sengas Government. However, currently, the Los Sengas Government has been disbanded.

Plots

Initial devleopment in different areas of Los Sengas usually involve a series of plots being set up in that area. Players who seek for a plot can apply for a plot through administrators who are online. However, most administrators nowadays adopt a development mode of high-density, high-storey building construction. Therefore, new plots in newer development areas have become rarer.

safeHtml:
'''Los Sengas NR Station Upgrade Scheme''' is a scheme that is divided into six phases. The aim of this scheme is to upgrade earlier existing stations in order to have them match the outlook and facilities of new stations. Most of the upgrading works involve facility upgrading and platform upgrading.

Aim

Nazca Railway adds in different advanced facilities and platform equipment in order to unify the system of all Nazca Railway stations in Los Sengas and help it mature.

Upgrading Works

Phase I

  • Advanced Station Facilities: Insert advanced station facilities for all stations, including "Station Control Room", "Station Souvenir", "Lavatories", "Station Maps" and "Coffee Shops".
  • Station Control Room: While Nazca Railway Stations in Terracept had Station Control Rooms, at the earliest days of the Los Sengas Division station control rooms were not set up. However, they resurfaced in Rover Down Checkpoint, and includes the following fafcilities:
  • Platform Screen Door Controls
  • In-Room Station Teleportation
  • Station Exit Switches
  • Station Souvenirs:
  • Some Souvenirs can be taken once only, but they can not be taken out of Los Sengas. However, some can be taken repeatedly, and other souvenirs involve challenges.
  • Due to city development and technical issues, some of the Station Souvenirs have been demolished (Ones that are demolished are denoted with a <s>strikethrough</s>).
  • Since the commencement of Phase V, they are gradually being replaced by the "NR Gauntlet"

  • [2]: Among the existing Station Souvenir Challenges, this one is the hardest. It requires at least two players. While one makes observations, the other does the challenge.
  • [3]: The station souvenirs at and are unofficial.
  • [4]: The station souvenir at is located at the station concourse of the CTRD Station fare area. However, the fare area for Cities Transport is shared with that for Nazca Railway.
  • Station Hopps: At later stages of Nazca Railway Station upgrades, station souvenirs are replaced by "Station Hopps" and are separated by two layers of glass in order to prevent sabotage, such as in Desert Field Station.
  • Due to historical reasons, most of the existing "Station Hopps" have disappeared, and Nazca Railway also ceased the setting up of Station Hopps. Only the glass remained where the station hopps once stood.
  • Lavatories: As its name suggests, lavatories are used for toiletries of passengers. Currently, all stations are equipped with lavatories.
  • Station Maps: Shows the maps of surrounding areas of any station that has ground-level faciltiies. However, Nazca Railway has ceased setting up station maps on newer stations.
  • Coffee Shops: Coffee Shops are formally named Los Sengas Coffee, and they are set up for passengers to obtain food and take a rest.
  • Platform Upgrading Works: Includes "Dynamic Speed Change" and "Closing Screen Doors Flashing Lights":
  • Dynamic Speed Change: Minecarts accelerate and decelerate in a smoother and more realistic behavior when entering and leaving stations.
  • Closing Screen Doors Flashing Lights: When doors of the train are about to close, flashing lights would appear on the platform screen doors. This is so that passengers will know that the train doors are about to close and would not break into the train should they fail to hear announcements.
  • Announcements: Insert "Train Arrival", "Next Station" announcements.

Phase II (ImageOnMap (IoM) Updating Works)

  • Using the ImageOnMap (IoM) mod, "Item Frames" can be self-definied and turned into exit signs, lavatory signs and platform signs.
  • Unfortunately, due to the saturation of the number of "ImageOnMap" frames, ImageOnMap signs are gradually phased out from Nazca Railway.

Phase III (SignPicture Updating Works Phase I)

  • Replacing all IoM Station signs with SignPicture Signs using the SignPicture Mod, as well as enabling the Nazca Railway Station Numbering and Directional System to appear on signs.

Phase IV (SignPicture Updating Works Phase II)

  • Replacing Entry Gate, Station Control Room and Platform Direction signage, which were still at IoM at the time, with SignPicture Signs.

Phase V (NR Station Gauntlet)

  • Turn the Station Souvenir challenges in Phase I into "NR Station Gauntlets".
  • Insert station banners that use the Small seal script.

Phase VI (Station Title)

  • The official name by NR is "Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme", which includes the following:
  • Adding a "Station Title" for every station.
  • Adding "Station Icons" that correspond to the title.
  • Replacing "Mind the Gap" signs with Line Icons for Platforms.

'''Los Sengas Permanent Corporations''' were a collective name of privately-run companies that have the permission to operate within Los Sengas in accordance with the ''Policy of Los Sengas Permanent Corporation''. However, no new applications have been managed since August 2 2020.

Policy of Los Sengas Permanent Corporation

Los Sengas (a.k.a. LS) is a modern theme city in a Minecraft world which for players to visit and develop there. As the city has established for almost a year, more and more players helped and contributed Los Sengas by visiting, building and organizing there. At the same time, when a player owns multiple land properties and wanted to grant government's (Administrators') advanced protection. The LS Government develops formal policy to players who want to establish companies in Los Sengas. Before applying a permanent corporation in Los Sengas, be sure to check out the followings whether you are eligible to apply:

  • Your warning record must be less than 2
  • You have owned no more than 3 permanent corporations
  • The corporation name must not be the same with the existing one in Los Sengas
  • The corporation should NOT be related to any political opinions
  • The corporation and its applicant should NOT be related to any concept or action against this society

How to apply a permanent corporation:

  • Please click this link to apply (https://goo.gl/forms/GafvmPcNRmyRF3Vx2)
  • You can apply at most 3 permanent corporations at a time, but do not own more than 3 permanent corporation after the application
  • Corporation name must NOT include any offensive or insulting word
  • “Group” or related structure is not considered as a “Permanent Corporation” and will be valid from 1st The Twelfth Month, Year 4
  • The decision of handling the application of Los Sengas Permanent Corporation shall be final

How to shut down a permanent corporation:

  • Please click this link to apply (https://goo.gl/forms/7nqOIDckgdh3oCbD3)

safeHtml:
This Page highlights the Los Sengas Regulations on classification and registration of Media organizations written by the Media and Broadcasting Authority (MBA) of the Los Sengas Government in both Chinese and English. It is written with the purpose of regulating Los Sengas Media as follows:

立例目的 Aim of regulation

為辨別媒體公司人員及普通市民，及協助合資格媒體人員得到管理人員適當協助<br /> To identify personnels of Media organizations from ordinary citizens and to offer appropriate aid when needed.

釋義 Interpretation

在本規定 中，除文意另有所指外─<br /> "總管理長"(chief administrator)指納斯卡計劃伺服器總管理長;<br /> "傳媒主管"(media director)指納斯卡計劃伺服器傳媒主管;<br /> "政府"指洛聖加政府。<br />

In this Ordinance, unless the context otherwise requires-<br /> "Chief administrator"means the chief administrator of the Project Nazca Server;<br /> "Media director"means the media director of the Project Nazca Server;<br /> "government"means the government of Los Sengas;<br />

媒體分類 Classification of Media Organizations

3.1.公共廣播機構(IGMG)<br /> 3.2.持牌媒體機構: 經指定程序獲政府發牌的媒體機構<br />

3.1.Public Service Broadcaster-the public corporation which provides media services(IGMG)<br /> 3.2.Licensed Media Organization- Media organizations licensed through a certain procedure<br />

媒體註冊程序 Registration of Media Organizations

4.1持牌媒體機構Licensed Media Organizations<br /> 持牌媒體機構負責人必需向政府提交完整計劃書, 經會議通過後發牌 A proposal should be submitted to the general meeting of the server, and be approved by two-third of the participants present.<br />

媒體牌照檢討 Media License Reviews

公共廣播機構及持牌媒體機構之牌照需每年檢討乙次, 以確保公共廣播機構及持牌媒體機構之質素。檢討前, 公共廣播機構及持牌媒體機構之負責人需向會議提交一份報告, 清說明其年度內所製作之內容, 及其來年發展方向。<br /> 政府可決定不為一媒體機構延續其牌照, 但必需預留一定通知期*<br />

  • 此安排不適用於公共廣播機構<br />

To maintain quality of the Public Service Broadcaster and the licensed media organizations,the review of media licenses shall be conducted annually.Before the review,the person in-charge of the organization reviewed should submit a report containing their productions produced and their future plans.<br /> The government may decide not to renew the license for a media organization,but adequate time should be given.*<br />

  • this is not applicable to the Public Service Broadcaster

媒體機構代號及發帖規定 Regulations on posts

所有媒體機構均將在注冊後獲編配一個代碼,以方便讀者識別其媒體類別及名稱。<br />

7.1發帖規定 Regulations on posts 所有媒體機構之發帖均須於其開首以以下格式書明其所屬機構,否則政府可在無需通知之情況下刪除其帖子-<br /> [媒體類別]-[名稱代碼]<br /> All posts issued by all media organizations shall show its code at the beginning of the post in the following format-<br /> [media category]-[code of media organization]

If any media organization fail to comply with the regualtion listed in section 7.1, the MBA may delete the post violating the rule without further notice.<br />

title: Los Sengas Transport
safeHtml:
Los Sengas Transport mainly consists of public transport. While rail transport in Los Sengas is the most prominent, water transport and road transport are also available. Moreover, private transport comes in the form of Horse Spawning Stations and Elytra.

Aviation Transport

Airports

Currently, Los Sengas has one airport. However, plans to build the Los Sengas International and Intergalactic Transport Hub (SITH) in the Egress Continent are also in place, and Peckern Continental Eternity International Airport is also under construction.

  • Mayler Airport (Sava Threeler, Private Airport, now transforming into a public airport)
  • Peckern Continental Eternity International Airport (Under Reconstruction)
  • Los Sengas International and Intergalactic Transport Hub (Proposed)

Airlines

The following are the airlines that have been registered under the Policy of Los Sengas Permanent Corporation:

  • Metropolis Airline
  • Nazca Railway Affiliated Airline Corporation
  • Hatace Airlines Corporation

Aeropspace Development

The following are the aerospace development companies that have been registered under the Policy of Los Sengas Permanent Corporation:

  • Domma Aviation Industry

Elytra

Elytras are a form of private air transport in Los Sengas that can rival road transport.

Rail Transport

The most prominent rail operator in Los Sengas is Nazca Railway, and the Los Sengas Division and Sava Light Transit (SLT) are both set in here. However, under the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme, other private rail company operators also provided railway servcies in Los Sengas. Rail transport in Los Sengas is managed by Nazca.

The below template highlights info for Rail Transport in Los Sengas:

Nazca Railway

Nazca Railway is the most prominent rail operator in Los Sengas, and it has stations across all different districts. In some areas, such as the Twenty-Second Continent, the rail network is even more well developed than the road network. This railway company can legally build railways across districts.

Sava Light Transit

While Sava Light Transit begun as the light rail subsidiary of Nazca Railway, and is named after the fact that it mainly served Sava, the transport network of SLT has since expanded to all districts in Los Sengas, and is no longer under NR. This railway company can also legally build railways across districts.

Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme

The Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme is a railway development scheme in Los Sengas for players to have the right to build railways to a limited extent and further enhance railway devleopment.

The below template highlights info for the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme:

Others

Other private railways not involved in the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme are usually based in West Metropolis Archipelago and is subject to West Metropolis Archipelago Regulations. In order to protect the balance of the WMA and not exceed player rights limits, cross-district railways are usually not possible.

Connecting Rail Systems

HAMGOSASHI LRT

HAMGOSASHI LRT is formerly the connecting rail system for Nazca Ferry. This company can also legally construct cross-district railways provided that the district has access to Nazca Ferry.

Maritime Transport

Most passenger ferries in Los Sengas is managed by Nazca Ferry, and container freight is managed by Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals, which is managed by MichaelLMY.

The below template highlights info for Los Sengas Maritime Transport:

Passenger Ferries

Nazca Ferry has set up the Los Sengas division in Los Sengas, which provides passenger ferry services. It is currently the largest passenger ferry operator in Los Sengas. However, Hatace Ferry has also seen rapid development in Los Sengas and is preparing to expand operations to different districts. Other ferry operators also provide cross-island ferry services in West Metropolis Archipelago.

  • Nazca Ferry
  • Hatace Ferry
  • Peckern Ferry
  • Nazca Railway (Subsidiary Ferry Company)
  • Egret Docks Ferry Coporation Limited

Container Freight

Most Maritime Freight transport is highly dependent on the Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals, the largest infrastructure project in Los Sengas to date. Moreover, Sanfo Island, Bulldoze Island and Hatace Island Governments have also set up their own minor container terminals on their own islands, and Miner Bay Depot of Nazca Railway also features its exclusive container terminal for train assembly.

  • Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals

Road Transport

The Road Transport Network in Los Sengas Continent is the most well-devleoped. However, most islands on West Metropolis Archipelago also have road networks on their own, which are respectively managed by their district administrators and developers.

Trunk Roads

Los Sengas has 20 public trunk roads which are named routes and 5 private trunk roads.

Other Roads

Currently, road networks at Downtown, Sava, West Metropolis Archipelago and Peckern Continent are the densest, and road networks in other areas are more sparse. While Nazca Railway tends to construct roads at the vicinity of new stations after Season 2, most roads on islands on West Metropolis Archipelago do not have external access.

Bus Network

The bus network in Los Sengas was managed by Department of Highways and Motor Vehicles, and the first round of bus licences and route registration commenced on August 31 2016. However, the management of the network was handed over to the United Council of Bus Companies in Los Sengas (LSUCBC) when it was established on August 15 2018.

More info on Los Sengas Bus routes can be seen here.

Private Transport

Due to server performance limitations, Los Sengas forbids the usage of "Spawn Eggs" for players. Only the publicly operated Horse Spawning Stations feature this service. Moreover, Elytras are also a popular choice of private transport.

title: Los Sengas Trunk Roads
safeHtml:
'''Los Sengas Trunk Roads''' act as main arteries for Los Sengas land transport, and provides direct and convenient access between different districts of Los Sengas.

Earlier Trunk Roads (Routes 1-7) are paved with gray concrete, whereas newer Trunk Roads, including newer sections of Route 7 and Routes numbered 8 or above, uses gray concrete instead. Most Trunk roads have more than two lanes for each side and are dual carriageways. All exits are either set on the left side of the road or are graded junctions. Moreover, a large majority of the trunk roads in Los Sengas are Motorways, and unlike in Hong Kong, tunnels can also be considered a part of the motorway. However, it is forbidden to change lanes in tunnels.

While the Trunk roads are formerly managed by the Department of Highways and Motor Vehicles, since the dissolvence of the Los Sengas Government, they are now managed by players instead.
